name: Oman
summary: No free movement for anyone; EU, US and other passports use the same routes. The Golden Residency programme (relaunched 31 August 2025, run through Invest Oman) gives 5 years for OMR 250,000 in an investment or property, or 10 years for OMR 500,000; retirees can qualify with OMR 4,000 a month. Foreign owners of qualifying property can also get an Owner Residence Permit. No remote-work visa was confirmed. Personal income tax starts in 2028.
naturalisation: Not researched in this pass. The golden residency does not give a claim to citizenship (Gulf News: beneficiaries cannot claim Omani citizenship).
dual_citizenship_note: General rule, not verified in this pass: Oman does not generally allow dual nationality.

routes.name: Golden Residency - 10 years
routes.summary: A 10-year renewable residence for investing OMR 500,000, buying OMR 500,000 of property, or creating a company with 50 Omani employees.
routes.requirements: Any one of: OMR 500,000 in an Omani LLC, public joint-stock company or government bonds; property worth OMR 500,000; a company employing at least 50 Omanis. Age 21+, valid health insurance. Applications through the Invest Oman platform. Program relaunched 31 August 2025 (Deloitte). Observer reports describe a lower RO 200,000 entry; unconfirmed.
routes.investment_options: Alternative with no capital minimum: company employing at least 50 Omanis.
routes.fees_note: Gulf News (Sep 2025): OMR 551. The 2021 programme fee for the principal investor was OMR 500 (Fragomen), so the current fee is unconfirmed.
routes.tax_note: No personal income tax until a 5% tax on income above OMR 42,000 starts in 2028 (Royal Decree 56/2025).

routes.name: Golden Residency - 5 years
routes.summary: A 5-year residence for investing OMR 250,000 in a company or buying OMR 250,000 of property.
routes.requirements: Any one of: OMR 250,000 in an LLC or public joint-stock company; property worth OMR 250,000. Age 21+. The 2021 programme also allowed OMR 250,000 in government bonds (Fragomen). Applications through Invest Oman.
routes.fees_note: Gulf News (Sep 2025): OMR 326; unconfirmed from an official page.
routes.tax_note: No personal income tax until 2028 (5% above OMR 42,000).

routes.name: Golden Residency - retirees (5 years)
routes.summary: Retirees showing a fixed income of OMR 4,000 a month can get a 5-year residence.
routes.requirements: OMR 4,000 a month (OMR 48,000 a year), fixed income. The 2021 rules (Fragomen) required retirement after at least two years of employment in Oman and a permanent home there; Gulf News says expat workers already living in Oman. Whether it is open to non-residents is unclear.
routes.physical_presence: Permanent place of residence in Oman (2021 rules).

routes.name: Owner Residence Permit (property owners)
routes.summary: Foreign buyers of qualifying property can apply for a sponsor-free permit valid while they own it.
routes.requirements: Savory & Partners (29 Jun 2026): valid 6 months to 1 year, renewable, no local sponsor, valid only while the qualifying property is owned, may cover first-degree family; no minimum investment specified. Executive regulations pending. Zawya also lists units in integrated tourism complexes, development bonds, listed shares and 5-year bank deposits under the Golden Residency.

routes.name: Employer-sponsored work residence
routes.summary: Most expatriates live in Oman on an employer-sponsored work visa and resident card.
routes.requirements: Employer applies through the Ministry of Labour and Royal Oman Police; Omanisation quotas apply. Not researched in detail.

open_questions: No official Invest Oman page was read; thresholds and fees come from Deloitte, Gulf News and Fragomen.

Gulf News and Oman Observer mention a RO 200,000 threshold and seven investment routes (company, bonds, listed shares, 5-year deposit, tourism-complex units); not reconciled with the OMR 250,000/500,000 tiers.
Government fees (OMR 326 and OMR 551) are from Gulf News only; Fragomen 2021 gave OMR 300 / OMR 500.
Oman digital nomad visa: Zawya mentions one with 'specific income requirements' but no amounts; other sources say none exists.
Naturalisation and dual-nationality rules not researched.
